svg.text: Turn 4: Bonus on cell 15, moved up 5
Turn 7: Skip on cell 42, turn lost
Turn 9: Warp on cell 67, sent to cell 54
Difficulty sets snake and ladder counts, saved in $_SESSION['difficulty']
Start game: PHP validates names, builds the board arrays, resets game state
Roll die: POST to game.php, rand(1,6), move, check hazards, save, redirect
Board: 100 cells from a PHP loop; E marks an event cell; active cell outlined
AI Narrator: story text from the event template, reads $_SESSION['last_event']
Event log from $_SESSION['events_log'], feeds the Adventure Recap
Log out: logout.php destroys the session and redirects to index.php
Win: reaching or passing cell 100 saves the result, redirects to leaderboard.php
